en: A black-and-white postcard photograph showing a large, multi-storey early‑20th‑century building with a mansard-style roof and many windows, identified as the new post office. It stands behind a row of trees and a riverside embankment, with older city buildings and church towers visible in the background. The caption at the bottom reads in German that this is the new post office building in Graz.
